issues.reason: The strength-0 bundle is scoped to the witness sk_fame_1 whose typing atom stands positive at top level — that is precisely the "not all / not every" counterexample-witness shape ("Not every intern replied"), not a blanket kind-level denial, which would have required a strength-0 Implication over (Member $x fame).

The counterexample-witness pattern for ¬∀ mints exactly such a positive witness for the quantified subject while any unquantified bare NP stays a constant, so the fame/success asymmetry is what that pattern prescribes rather than a defect.

The kind-relation route is reserved for a bare generic — "Only a bare relational generic becomes a kind relation", an explicit quantifier keeping the clause in rule/event form — and an opaque binary kind atom could not carry the counterexample that "not always" states.

Neither counterexample-witness example in the instruction set ("Not all swans are white", "Not every intern replied") emits a QuantifierPhrase companion; the companion accompanies a strength-bearing generalization, and this form has none — the positive subject typing outside the strength-0 bundle is what distinguishes it from a plain "not" denial.
